remarks: LOCATION! LOCATION! LOCATION! Nestled in a prime New Canaan neighborhood, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath colonial offers classic charm and a spacious layout, An incredible opportunity to make this your dream home. The main level features generous living spaces, including formal living room with fireplace, sun-filled family room with fireplace, a formal dining room, and a kitchen overlooking sunroom offers great potential for multiuse. Upstairs, the primary suite includes an en-suite bath and walk in closet., while three additional bedrooms and a full bath provide ample space. The lower level offers flexibility for a future playroom, home office, gym, etc... Situated on a beautiful lot in one of New Canaan's most sought-after neighborhoods, this home is just minutes from YMCA, top-rated schools, town, parks, and the train. A rare opportunity to find a location like this!!!
